fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc Data Science at Coventry? Here is what it costs, who can get in and when you can start.

The Data Science MSc is a one-year, full-time course at Coventry University in Coventry. It is taught in English. It aims to meet the demand for data professionals. You can add a professional placement, which makes the course up to 2 years.

**The most important fact for you:** you can apply with a degree in any subject, and tuition is **£19,980** for 2027-28.

You take **180 credits**. Four 30-credit modules cover Programming for Data Science, Data Analytics, The Data Science Professional, and Machine Learning and Big Data. You then do a **60-credit** Individual Research Project. If you pass The Data Science Professional, you can also get a CMI Level 7 Certificate at no extra cost. CMI is the Chartered Management Institute.

Coventry's course pages say their details are for 2026-27 entry and are guidance for 2027-28. The 2027-28 view shows the figures on this page.

For the wider university, see our [Coventry University page](/study-abroad/universities/coventry-university).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need an honours degree at 2:2 or above, or the international equivalent, in any discipline. A 2:2 is a UK honours grade, one below a 2:1.

**Indian marks.** Coventry's [India page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/c/welcome-india-students/) asks for **60%** in a three-year degree or **55%** in a four-year degree for postgraduate study.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall, with no component below **5.5**. If you fall short, the India page says you can take the Coventry University English Test.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Coventry's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

**Another option.** If you have a computer science, maths, statistics or engineering degree, Coventry also runs a [Data Science and Computational Intelligence MSc](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/course-structure/pg/ees/data-science-and-computational-intelligence-msc/). Its 2027-28 fee is also **£19,980**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£19,980** for 2027-28. The course is one year without a placement.

Coventry is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027-28, one-year course | £19,980 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,203 × 9 months | £10,827 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£32,529** |

The sum is £19,980 + £10,827 + £558 + £1,164 = £32,529. With the £2,000 scholarship below, it falls to **£30,529**. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule for courses outside London rises from **£1,171** to **£1,203** a month for visa applications made on or after **30 November 2026**. A September 2027 student applies in 2027, so plan on **£1,203** for each month of your course, up to **9 months** (£10,827). You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row, and the 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** You must pay the deposit on your offer letter before Coventry issues your CAS. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs. If you apply from **Punjab, Uttarakhand or Haryana**, you pay the full first-year tuition before the CAS. Coventry's table does not name other Indian states, so ask Coventry what deposit applies to you.

**Placement costs.** With a placement, your course lasts up to 2 years. You then pay a **£1,950** placement fee, and your visa, living money and health surcharge change. The total above is for the one-year course only.

**Fee rises.** Coventry says international fees may rise each year by no more than **5%** above inflation. Optional field trips cost from **£400** each.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

**Coventry University Group Scholarship:** **£2,000** off tuition for each full year of study. It is for self-funded international students starting in 2026/27 or 2027/28. There is no application. You must clear your full CAS deposit by the date in your offer letter and then enrol. Sponsored students cannot get it.

There is no India-only award on Coventry's scholarship pages. Read the [scholarship page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/apply-for-a-scholarship/coventry-university-group-scholarship/) for the full rules.

## Deadlines and intakes

The course runs six starts in 2027-28: **September 2027**, November 2027, **January 2028**, March 2028, May 2028 and July 2028.

| Intake | Final application deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|
| January 2027 | 1 December 2026 | Directly to Coventry, online |
| September 2027 | Not yet published | Directly to Coventry, online |

Coventry's [international deadline table](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/international-students-hub/apply/) runs only to July 2027 starts so far. For a January 2027 start you must also meet your offer conditions by **4 December 2026** and enrol by **1 February 2027**. Apply early for September 2027, so you have time for the deposit, CAS and visa.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule.** You need a 2:2 or above in any subject.
2. **Apply online.** Full-time international students apply directly to the university. Start from the [course page](https://www.coventry.ac.uk/course-structure/pg/ees/data-science-msc/).
3. **Prepare your documents.** Have your degree certificate and transcripts, your English test result and any translations ready.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the amount in your offer letter by its date. This also keeps you eligible for the £2,000 scholarship. Coventry then issues your CAS.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers support.** Coventry offers one-to-one guidance for up to **18 months** after your course. This covers placements, graduate jobs, CV checks and mentoring.
- **Placement.** You can extend the course with a professional placement of up to a year. You must find and secure it yourself in your first semester.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you want to move into data work from any degree subject
- you have about 60% (three-year degree) or 55% (four-year degree)
- you want a lower tuition fee and a choice of start months

**Think carefully if:**

- you already have a strong computing or maths degree and want a more technical course
- you want a fixed September deadline now, because it is not yet published
- you are from Punjab, Uttarakhand or Haryana, because you pay the full first-year tuition before your CAS

faq_json.a: Tuition is £19,980 for 2027-28. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £32,529, or £30,529 after the £2,000 scholarship.

faq_json.a: Yes. The course accepts a 2:2 or above in any discipline, or the international equivalent.

faq_json.a: Coventry's India page asks for 60% in a three-year degree or 55% in a four-year degree.

faq_json.q: Does Coventry need GRE or IELTS for Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 5.5.

faq_json.a: It is not yet published. Coventry's international table runs only to July 2027 starts so far.
